paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc is 4.98 as of September 18, with a 0.61 percent change from the prior close and a -13.54 percent change over a window of 22 sessions. There has been 1 new news item in the last 24 hours.

Fermi Inc has been in the news recently due to its announcement of a $350 million convertible notes offering, which caused the stock to decline 18 percent in after-hours trading on September 20, according to a report from Stocktwits.

There have been various SEC filings from Fermi Inc, including a total of 25 filings in the feed, with 3 of them being Form 4 filings, and 7 being proxy solicitation filings, the most recent of which include a PX14A6G form filed on September 11 and a Form 3 filed on September 3.
